fancybars.bars.config.explanation:
Welcome to the status bars config screen!

Drag and drop the bars to snap them to an anchor (white squares), existing bars or you can put them anywhere.
You can right click them to edit a bunch of properties.
By hovering your mouse between 2 bars (your cursor should change), you can resize them.

Everything is saved when you leave.

Use the gear button for general settings, or /fancybars config.
fancybars.bars.config.reset:
This will reset the status bars to their default positions.
This cannot be undone.
fancybars.config.enableBars.@Tooltip: Enables the fancy Health, Mana, Defense, Vitality, Speed, and XP Bars.
fancybars.config.enableBarsRift.@Tooltip: Also show the fancy bars while in the Rift.
fancybars.config.enableVanillaStyleManaB: Shows mana as a row of vanilla-style icons in place of the hunger bar. Only used when the fancy bars are disabled.
Enable Vanilla Style Mana Bar Blinking
Makes the vanilla-style mana bar blink when you use mana.
fancybars.config.hideMana: Hide Mana Consumption Messages from Action Bar
fancybars.config.hideMana.@Tooltip: Gives a better experience when using Fancy Status Bars.
fancybars.config.intelligenceDisplay.@To:
Original: overflow mana is drawn over the mana bar.
Accurate: the bar is split between mana and overflow mana.
Smallest In Front: whichever is smaller is drawn on top.
fancybars.config.riftHealthHP: Rift Health: HP instead of hearts
fancybars.config.riftHealthHP.@Tooltip: In the rift, if enabled, the health status bar will display HP (20, 19, 18, ...) instead of Hearts (10, 9.5, 9, ...)
fancybars.config.showEstimatedTilde.@Too: Displays a tilde (~) before a bar's value when it is estimated by FancyBars because it is not visible in the action bar.
fancybars.config.title: Fancy Bars Settings
fancybars.config.useHungerBarSprites.@To: Uses the vanilla hunger icons for the vanilla-style mana bar.
